components.name: Layer Name
components.description: A display name for the layer.

components.name: Initial Visibility
components.description: Whether the layer is on initially.

components.name: URL
components.description: URL to a vector tile source. Can be a direct tile URL with {z}/{x}/{y} placeholders (e.g., 'https://example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf') or a TileJSON endpoint (e.g., 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet') which will be resolved automatically.

components.name: Minimum Zoom
components.description: The lowest (smallest number) zoom level for which to show this layer.

components.name: Maximum Native Zoom
components.description: The highest (largest number) zoom level of the tile set.

components.name: Maximum Zoom
components.description: The highest (greatest number) zoom level for which to show this layer.

components.name: Initial Opacity
components.description: A value from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque) of the layer's initial opacity.

rows.subdescription: Controls which sublayers from the vector tiles are rendered in the 2D map and how they appear. Only sublayers listed here will be shown — all others are hidden. Example: { "building": { "fill": true, "fillColor": "#cccccc", "fillOpacity": 0.6, "weight": 0.5, "color": "#999999" } }

components.name: Vector Tile Style
components.description: An object mapping internal vector tile sublayer names to styles. Only listed sublayers will be rendered.

components.name: Vector Tile Feature Unique Id Key
components.description: Each feature of the vector tileset needs a property with a unique value to identify it. This required field is the name of that property.

components.name: Vector Tile Use Key as Name
components.description: (Optional) The property key whose value should be the hover text of each feature.

components.name: Height Property
components.description: Feature property containing height in meters for 3D extrusion on the globe (e.g., 'render_height', 'height').

components.name: Default Height (m)
components.description: Fallback height in meters when the height property is missing from a feature. Default: 10.

components.name: Base Height Property
components.description: Feature property containing the base height in meters (e.g., 'render_min_height'). Optional — used for buildings with elevated bases.

components.name: Extrusion Color
components.description: Color of extruded 3D polygons on the globe. Default: #cccccc.

components.name: Sublayer to Extrude
components.description: The name of the vector tile sublayer to extrude in 3D (e.g., 'building'). If empty, uses the first sublayer listed in the 2D Style.
